configuration: Shipped wearable capture, personal facts/conversation store, Daily Insights, Actions, and retained to-do suggestions, as specified for September 22. Future Templates are excluded.
sources_read: https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/devices/bee-amazon-wearable-ai-device-new-features — full product description; no version specified in case.yaml.
https://docs.bee.computer/docs/mcp — full documentation page; displayed last updated June 7, 2026.
https://docs.bee.computer/docs/proxy — full documentation page; displayed last updated June 7, 2026.

S->M.label: reported
S->M.rationale: Captured conversations become retained transcripts and summaries, and voice notes contribute to stored personal context. The documented fact creation and update operations also provide a write path for supplied evidence.
S->M.locator: [Product description](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/devices/bee-amazon-wearable-ai-device-new-features), introduction and Voice Notes/privacy paragraphs; [API documentation](https://docs.bee.computer/docs/proxy), Facts and Conversations.

M->A.label: reported
M->A.rationale: Bee uses accumulated history to generate personalized insights and recommend goals, establishing retained information influencing assistance content.
M->A.locator: [Product description](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/devices/bee-amazon-wearable-ai-device-new-features), What we’ve learned and Daily Insights bullet.
M->A.quote: Bee surfaces insights across months of conversations, emails, calendar data, and health metrics from HealthKit

A->S.label: insufficient
A->S.rationale: User-controlled capture, Actions, and streaming interfaces are described, but no passage establishes Bee's plans or execution state directing observation acquisition, interpretation, or expected-effect checks.
A->S.locator: [Product description](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/devices/bee-amazon-wearable-ai-device-new-features), capture paragraph and Actions bullet; [API documentation](https://docs.bee.computer/docs/proxy), Streaming.

M->S.label: insufficient
M->S.rationale: Historical context informs insights, but the sources do not establish retained priors guiding ongoing sampling, attention, compression, or interpretation. Context retrieval alone does not establish this channel.
M->S.locator: [Product description](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/devices/bee-amazon-wearable-ai-device-new-features), What we’ve learned and Daily Insights; [MCP documentation](https://docs.bee.computer/docs/mcp), What this is and Tool catalog.

A->M.label: reported
A->M.rationale: Generated to-do suggestions remain available for subsequent retrieval and acceptance or dismissal. Retention of these proposed actions establishes this flow without requiring evidence that executed emails or calendar operations are logged.
A->M.locator: [MCP documentation](https://docs.bee.computer/docs/mcp), Tool catalog, bee_get_todo_suggestions, bee_accept_todo_suggestion, and bee_dismiss_todo_suggestion.

record.label: stated
record.rationale: The documented getter exposes retained to-do suggestions: records of behavior Bee proposed. This establishes recording of recommendations, not necessarily completed external executions.

outcome.label: not_stated
outcome.rationale: Acceptance/dismissal operations and a stored todo completion field are documented, but retention of suggestion responses or outcomes linked to Bee's own actions is not specified.
outcome.locator: [MCP documentation](https://docs.bee.computer/docs/mcp), Tool catalog, suggestion acceptance/dismissal; [API documentation](https://docs.bee.computer/docs/proxy), Todos, update example.

attribution.label: not_stated
attribution.rationale: Item-specific response controls exist, but the sources do not describe Bee checking a prior decision against its outcome or using that outcome to correct assistance.
attribution.locator: [MCP documentation](https://docs.bee.computer/docs/mcp), Tool catalog; [Product description](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/devices/bee-amazon-wearable-ai-device-new-features), Actions and Daily Insights.

revision.label: not_stated
revision.rationale: Accumulating personal context and developer-shipped features do not establish a durable mechanism change made by the service itself.
revision.locator: [Product description](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/devices/bee-amazon-wearable-ai-device-new-features), introduction and Accelerating with Amazon; [API documentation](https://docs.bee.computer/docs/proxy), Facts and Todos.
revision.what: No service-authored revision to parameters, prompts, skills, reusable rules, code, or harness is stated.

later_use.label: not_stated
later_use.rationale: No run under a service-revised mechanism is reported; use of accumulated personal information is not evidence of such a run.
later_use.locator: [Product description](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/devices/bee-amazon-wearable-ai-device-new-features), What we’ve learned and Accelerating with Amazon.

notes: Independent text-only review of the three listed primary sources; no code repository was supplied. Documentation interfaces establish the specified stores and controls, but unspecified feedback retention and autonomous mechanism changes were not inferred.
